title: The canonical module and abelian coefficient factors
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, W a scheme, G a module sheaf on its small etale site, q an integer, A and B objects of Over W, and f:A→B. Construct a morphism D⁺f*Λ((B.hom*G)[0][q])→(A.hom*G)[0][q] as the shift comparison for derived inverse image at higherDirectImageRawOverComplex(Λ,G,B) [def-sbc-higher-image-raw-over-complex], followed by shift(q) applied to higherDirectImageRawOverCoefficient(Λ,G,f) [def-sbc-higher-image-raw-over-coefficient]. Independently, for any abelian sheaf H on W, construct D⁺f*Ab((B.hom*H)[0][q])→(A.hom*H)[0][q] as its shift comparison followed by shift(q) applied to the composite of the single comparison and singleFunctor of inverse upperStarComp at H [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. These are the existing module and abelian coefficient factors of lem-sbc-raw-scalar-coefficient-square, with unchanged public types and maps, relocated to their canonical definitions module.

noncomputable def moduleCoefficientFactor
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        ((higherDirectImageRawOverComplex Λ G B)⟦q⟧) ⟶
      (higherDirectImageRawOverComplex Λ G A)⟦q⟧
lean.note: The module coefficient factor names the existing higherDirectImageRawOverComplex endpoints in its type to keep derived comparisons folded. Its construction is byte-for-byte unchanged, and the endpoint types are definitionally equal to the previous explicit single complexes. No mathematical statement or unit route changes.
